# VIKTOR Documentation

> VIKTOR is a low-code platform for building and sharing engineering applications with Python. This documentation covers how to create, publish, and maintain VIKTOR apps using the Python SDK.


## docs

API

- [VIKTOR API](https://docs.viktor.ai/docs/api.md): API

### welcome

VIKTOR is a platform that makes it easy to create powerful and user-friendly apps. Create apps to automate your workflow, integrate with different software packages, and get better insights into your project through interactive visualizations.

- [Welcome to VIKTOR!](https://docs.viktor.ai/docs/welcome.md): VIKTOR is a platform that makes it easy to create powerful and user-friendly apps. Create apps to automate your workflow, integrate with different software packages, and get better insights into your project through interactive visualizations.
